   172	  "${FIRM_NAME} 12-section draft (pre-validate)" >/dev/null
   173	
   174	if ! bash "${CTX_AGENT_DIR}/validate.sh" "${DRAFT_PATH}"; then
   175	  printf 'cycle.sh: Gate A failed; draft NOT moved to vault\n' >&2
   176	  rm -f "${DRAFT_PATH}"
   177	  exit 3
   178	fi
   179	
   180	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   181	# Step 13 — Atomic vault write (per ADR-003 §3.3.4 atomic-write protocol)
   182	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   183	
   184	mv -f "${DRAFT_PATH}" "${REPORT_PATH}"
   185	chmod 600 "${REPORT_PATH}"
   186	
   187	# Final report output row per agent.md §3 audit-row signature
   188	hh_decision_output "diagnostic_report" "${REPORT_PATH}" \
   189	  "12-section report on ${FIRM_NAME}" >/dev/null
   190	
   191	hh_decision_action "diagnostic_report_render" "firm:${FIRM_SLUG}" \
   192	  "$(shasum "${REPORT_PATH}" | awk '{print $1}')" \
   193	  "$(printf '{"vault_path":"%s","firm_name":"%s","tenant":"%s"}' \
   194	      "${REPORT_PATH}" "${FIRM_NAME}" "${CTX_TENANT_SLUG}")" >/dev/null
   195	
   196	printf '\n\033[1;32mDiagnostic report written:\033[0m %s\n' "${REPORT_PATH}"
   197	
   198	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   199	# Step 14 — Optional notify
   200	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   201	
   202	if [[ "${NOTIFY_VIA}" == "telegram" ]]; then
   203	  if [[ -n "${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN:-}" && -n "${TELEGRAM_OPERATOR_CHAT_ID:-}" ]]; then
   204	    SUMMARY=$(head -200 "${REPORT_PATH}" | sed 's/[^[:print:][:space:]]//g' | head -c 200)
   205	
   206	    # Emit decision_log row BEFORE the send per agent.md §4 Step 11 spec —
   207	    # operator_notify_telegram is green-tier per autosend-policy.yaml so the
   208	    # send executes regardless; this row records the action for audit.
   209	    NOTIFY_PAYLOAD=$(printf '{"recipient":"operator","chat_id":"%s","report_path":"%s","firm":"%s","summary_len":%d}' \
   210	      "${TELEGRAM_OPERATOR_CHAT_ID}" \
   211	      "${REPORT_PATH}" \
   212	      "${FIRM_NAME}" \
   213	      "${#SUMMARY}")
   214	    hh_decision_action "operator_notify_telegram" "operator:${TELEGRAM_OPERATOR_CHAT_ID}" \
   215	      "$(echo "${NOTIFY_PAYLOAD}" | shasum | awk '{print $1}')" \
   216	      "${NOTIFY_PAYLOAD}" 2>/dev/null || true
   217	
   218	    curl -s -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage" \
   219	      -d "chat_id=${TELEGRAM_OPERATOR_CHAT_ID}" \
   220	      -d "text=Diagnostic report ready: ${FIRM_NAME} → ${REPORT_PATH}%0A%0A${SUMMARY}..." \
   221	      >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
   222	      printf 'cycle.sh: telegram notify failed (non-fatal)\n' >&2
   223	  else
   224	    printf 'cycle.sh: --notify-via telegram set but credentials missing; skipped\n' >&2
   225	  fi
   226	fi
   227	
   228	# Call cleanup (drop transient LinkedIn cache per ToS gotcha §6.1)
   229	bash "${CTX_AGENT_DIR}/cleanup.sh" 2>/dev/null || true

   231	exit 0

Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). ./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T150519Z-84855/agents_recruitment_sourcing-scout_agent-md.output.md:3054:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:161:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `action_type='consultant_feedback'` (registered green-tier action_type per `agents/_shared/autosend-policy.yaml`); outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with the registered `consultant_feedback` action_type rather than a new sentinel.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T121942Z-25986/docs_decisions_ADR-006-diagnostic-gate-a-hybrid-md.output.md:1126:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:16:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A hard-fails on any section missing its citation. (Per-claim citation validation is a W4 polish item; the v0 contract requires per-section coverage as a tractable Gate-A check.) The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

./agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:16:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A's per-section citation subcheck hard-fails on any section missing its citation, per `docs/decisions/ADR-006-diagnostic-gate-a-hybrid.md` (Accepted; Day 19 founder-arbitrated). ADR-006 establishes Gate A as per-section hard-fail; per-claim citation analysis is a separate post-launch quality metric outside Gate A (future W4 ADR + schema supplements). The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (target voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`; v0 implementation warns + exits 0 when `IFOS_VOICE_CLASSIFIER_URL` is unreachable per §5 honesty note — W4 polish closes this to unconditional hard-fail) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).
./agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:43:## §3 — The 12 required sections
./agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:148:**Per ADR-006 (canonical interpretation of ULTRAPLAN §8.1 A1 line 496 Gate A clause "no claims unsupported by source data"):** Gate A's citation subcheck is per-section hard-fail (every one of the 12 sections has ≥1 evidence link). Per-claim citation analysis is a SEPARATE post-launch quality metric, NOT Gate A — to be authored as a future W4 ADR with schema supplements when the voice-classifier microservice ships + first pilot tenant accumulates ≥30 reports.
./agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:161:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `action_type='consultant_feedback'` (registered green-tier action_type per `agents/_shared/autosend-policy.yaml`); outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with the registered `consultant_feedback` action_type rather than a new sentinel.
./agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:163:Gate B is a local leading metric for Diagnostic quality; it does NOT feed any v1.0 kill-criterion trigger directly. (Per bilateral-disposition Cat-3 at `docs/decisions/codex-disagreement-2026-05-24-diagnostic-gate-a.md`: kill-criterion §2 Trigger 8 is revenue uplift after 3 completed pilots, not Diagnostic conversion. A separate agent-specific Trigger 11 may be added in v1.1 if conversion-driven scope cuts become operationally relevant.) Below 30% sustained for 4 weeks → revisit Diagnostic's output quality at next Sunday review.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T144919Z-68982/agents_recruitment_cash-conductor_agent-md.output.md:2324:agents/recruitment/scribe/agent.md:16:> **Scribe ingests a call transcript from Fathom / Fireflies / Ringover (webhook-triggered within 30 seconds of call end) and produces TWO outputs:** (1) a structured Bullhorn write payload populating ≥3 placement-relevant fields on the appropriate entity (candidate / contractor / contact / brief / opportunity / placement per the call context), and (2) one tacit-note Markdown artefact written to `/vault/<tenant>/scribe-notes/<call_id>-<ISO-date>.md` containing the consultant's "things I'd write down but there's no field for" observations. The tacit-note vault artefact is also mirrored as a Bullhorn `Note` attachment on the resolved entity (consultant-visible in their ATS); the vault copy is the canonical narrative source per ADR-002 vault/Postgres split. End-to-end SLA: post-call note in Bullhorn within 10 minutes of webhook receipt per master brief §8.2 line 597. Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). Bullhorn writes are yellow-tier per `autosend-safety-policy.yaml`; tacit-notes are voice-classified (≥0.75 score) per master brief §8.1 Change 1.
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T144919Z-68982/agents_recruitment_cash-conductor_agent-md.output.md:2342:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:161:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `action_type='consultant_feedback'` (registered green-tier action_type per `agents/_shared/autosend-policy.yaml`); outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with the registered `consultant_feedback` action_type rather than a new sentinel.

./docs/architecture/second-brain-design.md:751:v1.0 agents per master brief §8.2: Diagnostic (no vault writes; sales-only), Janitor (heavy writes — nightly batch of thousands of Bullhorn entity updates), Scribe (per-call writes; ~30-60 min/day per consultant per Product Spec §2.2 R6), Cash Conductor (writes Placement updates on invoice events; reads heavily for invoice context), Sourcing Scout (read-heavy; produces drafts that the agent itself writes elsewhere), Concierge (per-lifecycle-event writes; reads candidate state on every inbound).

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T102316Z-23548/agents_recruitment_cash-conductor_agent-md.output.md:1613:agents/recruitment/scribe/agent.md:16:> **Scribe ingests a call transcript from Fathom / Fireflies / Ringover (webhook-triggered within 30 seconds of call end) and produces TWO outputs:** (1) a structured Bullhorn write payload populating ≥3 placement-relevant fields on the appropriate entity (candidate / contractor / contact / brief / opportunity / placement per the call context), and (2) one tacit-note Markdown attachment containing the consultant's "things I'd write down but there's no field for" observations. End-to-end SLA: post-call note in Bullhorn within 10 minutes of webhook receipt per master brief §8.2 line 597. Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). Bullhorn writes are yellow-tier per `autosend-safety-policy.yaml`; tacit-notes are voice-classified (≥0.75 score) per master brief §8.1 Change 1.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T113139Z-84869/agents_recruitment_sourcing-scout_agent-md.output.md:4398:agents/recruitment/scribe/agent.md:16:> **Scribe ingests a call transcript from Fathom / Fireflies / Ringover (webhook-triggered within 30 seconds of call end) and produces TWO outputs:** (1) a structured Bullhorn write payload populating ≥3 placement-relevant fields on the appropriate entity (candidate / contractor / contact / brief / opportunity / placement per the call context), and (2) one tacit-note Markdown artefact written to `/vault/<tenant>/scribe-notes/<call_id>-<ISO-date>.md` containing the consultant's "things I'd write down but there's no field for" observations. The tacit-note vault artefact is also mirrored as a Bullhorn `Note` attachment on the resolved entity (consultant-visible in their ATS); the vault copy is the canonical narrative source per ADR-002 vault/Postgres split. End-to-end SLA: post-call note in Bullhorn within 10 minutes of webhook receipt per master brief §8.2 line 597. Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). Bullhorn writes are yellow-tier per `autosend-safety-policy.yaml`; tacit-notes are voice-classified (≥0.75 score) per master brief §8.1 Change 1.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T112917Z-82352/agents_recruitment_scribe_agent-md.output.md:321:> **Scribe ingests a call transcript from Fathom / Fireflies / Ringover (webhook-triggered within 30 seconds of call end) and produces TWO outputs:** (1) a structured Bullhorn write payload populating ≥3 placement-relevant fields on the appropriate entity (candidate / contractor / contact / brief / opportunity / placement per the call context), and (2) one tacit-note Markdown artefact written to `/vault/<tenant>/scribe-notes/<call_id>-<ISO-date>.md` containing the consultant's "things I'd write down but there's no field for" observations. The tacit-note vault artefact is also mirrored as a Bullhorn `Note` attachment on the resolved entity (consultant-visible in their ATS); the vault copy is the canonical narrative source per ADR-002 vault/Postgres split. End-to-end SLA: post-call note in Bullhorn within 10 minutes of webhook receipt per master brief §8.2 line 597. Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). Bullhorn writes are yellow-tier per `autosend-safety-policy.yaml`; tacit-notes are voice-classified (≥0.75 score) per master brief §8.1 Change 1.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T112917Z-82352/agents_recruitment_scribe_agent-md.prompt.md:308:> **Scribe ingests a call transcript from Fathom / Fireflies / Ringover (webhook-triggered within 30 seconds of call end) and produces TWO outputs:** (1) a structured Bullhorn write payload populating ≥3 placement-relevant fields on the appropriate entity (candidate / contractor / contact / brief / opportunity / placement per the call context), and (2) one tacit-note Markdown artefact written to `/vault/<tenant>/scribe-notes/<call_id>-<ISO-date>.md` containing the consultant's "things I'd write down but there's no field for" observations. The tacit-note vault artefact is also mirrored as a Bullhorn `Note` attachment on the resolved entity (consultant-visible in their ATS); the vault copy is the canonical narrative source per ADR-002 vault/Postgres split. End-to-end SLA: post-call note in Bullhorn within 10 minutes of webhook receipt per master brief §8.2 line 597. Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). Bullhorn writes are yellow-tier per `autosend-safety-policy.yaml`; tacit-notes are voice-classified (≥0.75 score) per master brief §8.1 Change 1.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T151757Z-97714/agents_recruitment_sourcing-scout_agent-md.output.md:2279:agents/recruitment/scribe/agent.md:16:> **Scribe ingests a call transcript from Fathom / Fireflies / Ringover (webhook-triggered within 30 seconds of call end) and produces TWO outputs:** (1) a structured Bullhorn write payload populating ≥3 placement-relevant fields on the appropriate entity (candidate / contractor / contact / brief / opportunity / placement per the call context), and (2) one tacit-note Markdown artefact written to `/vault/<tenant>/scribe-notes/<call_id>-<ISO-date>.md` containing the consultant's "things I'd write down but there's no field for" observations. The tacit-note vault artefact is also mirrored as a Bullhorn `Note` attachment on the resolved entity (consultant-visible in their ATS); the vault copy is the canonical narrative source per ADR-002 vault/Postgres split. End-to-end SLA: post-call note in Bullhorn within 10 minutes of webhook receipt per master brief §8.2 line 597. Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). Bullhorn writes are yellow-tier per `autosend-safety-policy.yaml`; tacit-notes are voice-classified (≥0.75 score) per master brief §8.1 Change 1.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T115042Z-904/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:321:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A hard-fails on any section missing its citation. (Per-claim citation validation is a W4 polish item; the v0 contract requires per-section coverage as a tractable Gate-A check.) The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T115042Z-904/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:348:## §3 — The 12 required sections
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T115042Z-904/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:474:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `payload.action_type='consultant_feedback'`; outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with a payload action_type marker rather than a new sentinel.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T115042Z-904/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:942:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:16:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A hard-fails on any section missing its citation. (Per-claim citation validation is a W4 polish item; the v0 contract requires per-section coverage as a tractable Gate-A check.) The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T115042Z-904/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:955:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:169:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `payload.action_type='consultant_feedback'`; outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with a payload action_type marker rather than a new sentinel.
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T115042Z-904/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:956:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:171:Gate B is a local leading metric for Diagnostic quality; it does NOT feed any v1.0 kill-criterion trigger directly. (Per bilateral-disposition Cat-3 at `docs/decisions/codex-disagreement-2026-05-24-diagnostic-gate-a.md`: kill-criterion §2 Trigger 8 is revenue uplift after 3 completed pilots, not Diagnostic conversion. A separate agent-specific Trigger 11 may be added in v1.1 if conversion-driven scope cuts become operationally relevant.) Below 30% sustained for 4 weeks → revisit Diagnostic's output quality at next Sunday review.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T115042Z-904/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:1993:    16	> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A hard-fails on any section missing its citation. (Per-claim citation validation is a W4 polish item; the v0 contract requires per-section coverage as a tractable Gate-A check.) The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T115042Z-904/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:2991:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:16:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A hard-fails on any section missing its citation. (Per-claim citation validation is a W4 polish item; the v0 contract requires per-section coverage as a tractable Gate-A check.) The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `payload.action_type='consultant_feedback'`; outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with a payload action_type marker rather than a new sentinel.

Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). Bullhorn writes are yellow-tier per `autosend-safety-policy.yaml`; tacit-notes are voice-classified (≥0.75 score) per master brief §8.1 Change 1.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T150022Z-81292/agents_recruitment_sourcing-scout_agent-md.output.md:1236:agents/recruitment/scribe/agent.md:16:> **Scribe ingests a call transcript from Fathom / Fireflies / Ringover (webhook-triggered within 30 seconds of call end) and produces TWO outputs:** (1) a structured Bullhorn write payload populating ≥3 placement-relevant fields on the appropriate entity (candidate / contractor / contact / brief / opportunity / placement per the call context), and (2) one tacit-note Markdown artefact written to `/vault/<tenant>/scribe-notes/<call_id>-<ISO-date>.md` containing the consultant's "things I'd write down but there's no field for" observations. The tacit-note vault artefact is also mirrored as a Bullhorn `Note` attachment on the resolved entity (consultant-visible in their ATS); the vault copy is the canonical narrative source per ADR-002 vault/Postgres split. End-to-end SLA: post-call note in Bullhorn within 10 minutes of webhook receipt per master brief §8.2 line 597. Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). Bullhorn writes are yellow-tier per `autosend-safety-policy.yaml`; tacit-notes are voice-classified (≥0.75 score) per master brief §8.1 Change 1.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T150022Z-81292/agents_recruitment_sourcing-scout_agent-md.output.md:1893:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:161:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `action_type='consultant_feedback'` (registered green-tier action_type per `agents/_shared/autosend-policy.yaml`); outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with the registered `consultant_feedback` action_type rather than a new sentinel.
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T150022Z-81292/agents_recruitment_sourcing-scout_agent-md.output.md:1894:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:163:Gate B is a local leading metric for Diagnostic quality; it does NOT feed any v1.0 kill-criterion trigger directly. A separate agent-specific Trigger 11 may be added in v1.1 if conversion-driven scope cuts become operationally relevant.) Below 30% sustained for 4 weeks → revisit Diagnostic's output quality at next Sunday review.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T122440Z-32123/docs_decisions_ADR-006-diagnostic-gate-a-hybrid-md.prompt.md:348:The "no claims unsupported by source data" clause implies **per-claim citation validation** — every factual claim in the report must have a backing source link. The Diagnostic v0 implementation at `agents/recruitment/diagnostic/validate.sh` enforces **per-section citation** (regex `\[.+\]\(.+\)` requires ≥1 markdown link per section); per-claim validation is NOT implemented at v0.
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T122440Z-32123/docs_decisions_ADR-006-diagnostic-gate-a-hybrid-md.prompt.md:350:(Voice classifier ≥ 0.75 and PII boundary checks are also Gate A requirements per the same v0 contract. These warn-only-paths exist in v0 but are not affected by this ADR; this ADR addresses ONLY the "no claims unsupported by source data" clause from line 496.)
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T122440Z-32123/docs_decisions_ADR-006-diagnostic-gate-a-hybrid-md.prompt.md:370:Every one of the 12 sections in the rendered Diagnostic Markdown report MUST contain ≥1 evidence link (markdown link of the form `[label](url)`). Implemented at `agents/recruitment/diagnostic/validate.sh` via regex check per section heading. Hard-fail on miss → `ESC_AGENT_OUTPUT_SHAPE`. **No warn-only paths in Gate A.** This satisfies Rule 4 (Quality gates before features) — Gate A is unambiguously hard-fail; the upstream ULTRAPLAN clause "no claims unsupported by source data" is interpreted as "every section has at least one evidence link", consistent with the implementation.

Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A hard-fails on any section missing its citation. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T124427Z-47109/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.prompt.md:463:**Per ADR-006 (canonical interpretation of ULTRAPLAN §8.1 A1 line 496 Gate A clause "no claims unsupported by source data"):** Gate A's citation subcheck is per-section hard-fail (every one of the 12 sections has ≥1 evidence link). ./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T124427Z-47109/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.prompt.md:476:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `payload.action_type='consultant_feedback'`; outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with a payload action_type marker rather than a new sentinel.
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T124427Z-47109/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.prompt.md:478:Gate B is a local leading metric for Diagnostic quality; it does NOT feed any v1.0 kill-criterion trigger directly. (Per bilateral-disposition Cat-3 at `docs/decisions/codex-disagreement-2026-05-24-diagnostic-gate-a.md`: kill-criterion §2 Trigger 8 is revenue uplift after 3 completed pilots, not Diagnostic conversion. A separate agent-specific Trigger 11 may be added in v1.1 if conversion-driven scope cuts become operationally relevant.) Below 30% sustained for 4 weeks → revisit Diagnostic's output quality at next Sunday review.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T100618Z-10709/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.prompt.md:343:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least one evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) backing every factual claim — Gate A hard-fails on missing citations. The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T124427Z-47109/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:321:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A's per-section citation subcheck hard-fails on any section missing its citation, per `docs/decisions/ADR-006-diagnostic-gate-a-hybrid.md` (Accepted; Day 19 founder-arbitrated). ADR-006 establishes Gate A as per-section hard-fail; per-claim citation analysis is a separate post-launch quality metric outside Gate A (future W4 ADR + schema supplements). The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T124427Z-47109/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:348:## §3 — The 12 required sections
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T124427Z-47109/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:476:**Per ADR-006 (canonical interpretation of ULTRAPLAN §8.1 A1 line 496 Gate A clause "no claims unsupported by source data"):** Gate A's citation subcheck is per-section hard-fail (every one of the 12 sections has ≥1 evidence link). Per-claim citation analysis is a SEPARATE post-launch quality metric, NOT Gate A — to be authored as a future W4 ADR with schema supplements when the voice-classifier microservice ships + first pilot tenant accumulates ≥30 reports.
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T124427Z-47109/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:489:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `payload.action_type='consultant_feedback'`; outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with a payload action_type marker rather than a new sentinel.
./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T124427Z-47109/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:491:Gate B is a local leading metric for Diagnostic quality; it does NOT feed any v1.0 kill-criterion trigger directly. (Per bilateral-disposition Cat-3 at `docs/decisions/codex-disagreement-2026-05-24-diagnostic-gate-a.md`: kill-criterion §2 Trigger 8 is revenue uplift after 3 completed pilots, not Diagnostic conversion. A separate agent-specific Trigger 11 may be added in v1.1 if conversion-driven scope cuts become operationally relevant.) Below 30% sustained for 4 weeks → revisit Diagnostic's output quality at next Sunday review.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T124427Z-47109/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:1351:./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T115355Z-4405/agents_recruitment_scribe_agent-md.output.md:321:> **Scribe ingests a call transcript from Fathom / Fireflies / Ringover (webhook-triggered within 30 seconds of call end) and produces TWO outputs:** (1) a structured Bullhorn write payload populating ≥3 placement-relevant fields on the appropriate entity (candidate / contractor / contact / brief / opportunity / placement per the call context), and (2) one tacit-note Markdown artefact written to `/vault/<tenant>/scribe-notes/<call_id>-<ISO-date>.md` containing the consultant's "things I'd write down but there's no field for" observations. The tacit-note vault artefact is also mirrored as a Bullhorn `Note` attachment on the resolved entity (consultant-visible in their ATS); the vault copy is the canonical narrative source per ADR-002 vault/Postgres split. End-to-end SLA: post-call note in Bullhorn within 10 minutes of webhook receipt per master brief §8.2 line 597. Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). Bullhorn writes are yellow-tier per `autosend-safety-policy.yaml`; tacit-notes are voice-classified (≥0.75 score) per master brief §8.1 Change 1.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T130117Z-63874/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.prompt.md:308:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A's per-section citation subcheck hard-fails on any section missing its citation, per `docs/decisions/ADR-006-diagnostic-gate-a-hybrid.md` (Accepted; Day 19 founder-arbitrated). The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (target voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`; v0 implementation warns + exits 0 when `IFOS_VOICE_CLASSIFIER_URL` is unreachable per §5 honesty note — W4 polish closes this to unconditional hard-fail) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T130117Z-63874/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.prompt.md:438:**Per ADR-006 (canonical interpretation of ULTRAPLAN §8.1 A1 line 496 Gate A clause "no claims unsupported by source data"):** Gate A's citation subcheck is per-section hard-fail (every one of the 12 sections has ≥1 evidence link). ./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T130117Z-63874/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.prompt.md:451:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `action_type='consultant_feedback'` (registered green-tier action_type per `agents/_shared/autosend-policy.yaml`); outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with the registered `consultant_feedback` action_type rather than a new sentinel.

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T130117Z-63874/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:321:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A's per-section citation subcheck hard-fails on any section missing its citation, per `docs/decisions/ADR-006-diagnostic-gate-a-hybrid.md` (Accepted; Day 19 founder-arbitrated). ADR-006 establishes Gate A as per-section hard-fail; per-claim citation analysis is a separate post-launch quality metric outside Gate A (future W4 ADR + schema supplements). The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (target voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`; v0 implementation warns + exits 0 when `IFOS_VOICE_CLASSIFIER_URL` is unreachable per §5 honesty note — W4 polish closes this to unconditional hard-fail) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

Gate A hard-fails any transcript that doesn't produce ≥3 structured-field extractions AND 1 tacit-note with confidence ≥0.6 (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 524). Gate B success threshold: 90% of calls processed within 5 minutes; consultant edit-rate on structured fields ≤20% (per ULTRAPLAN A3 line 525). ./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T130117Z-63874/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:1429:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:16:> **Diagnostic produces a single Markdown report at `/vault/<tenant>/diagnostic-reports/<firm-slug>-<ISO-date>.md`** that diagnoses one named UK firm's recruitment-buying signals. The report has exactly **12 sections** (enumerated in §3 below). Each section MUST contain at least **one** evidence link (Companies House URL, LinkedIn URL, or careers-page URL) — Gate A's per-section citation subcheck hard-fails on any section missing its citation, per `docs/decisions/ADR-006-diagnostic-gate-a-hybrid.md` (Accepted; Day 19 founder-arbitrated). ADR-006 establishes Gate A as per-section hard-fail; per-claim citation analysis is a separate post-launch quality metric outside Gate A (future W4 ADR + schema supplements). The report ends with a **2-3 sentence conversation opener** written in the consultant's voice (target voice-classifier ≥ 0.75 per `common-voice.json`; v0 implementation warns + exits 0 when `IFOS_VOICE_CLASSIFIER_URL` is unreachable per §5 honesty note — W4 polish closes this to unconditional hard-fail) suitable for cold outreach to the firm's hiring decision-maker. **No external sends** — Diagnostic writes to vault only; consultant reads + uses for prospect calls or directly pastes the conversation opener into LinkedIn/email manually. Typical report length: 600-1000 words. Gate B (success threshold): ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports result in a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation (per Ultraplan §8.1 A1).

./logs/codex-ratification/20260524T130117Z-63874/agents_recruitment_diagnostic_agent-md.output.md:1468:agents/recruitment/diagnostic/agent.md:159:Per Ultraplan §8.1 A1: ≥ 30% of Diagnostic reports lead to a discovery call booked within 14 days of generation. Measured by consultant feedback loop — Telegram reply `/diagnostic-feedback <report-id> booked|not-booked` (v1.0) or Brain UI button (v1.1). Aggregated as `decision_log` rows with `agent_name='diagnostic'` + `phase='action'` + `action_type='consultant_feedback'` (registered green-tier action_type per `agents/_shared/autosend-policy.yaml`); outcome metric computed by Gate-B rollup query at the weekly review (not stored as a single `decision_log.payload` field). Sentinel agent_names (`_renderer`, `_tenant_admin`, `_codex_ratifier`) are reserved for system actors — consultant feedback is conceptually Diagnostic's domain (validating Diagnostic's output), so the firing agent_name is `diagnostic` with the registered `consultant_feedback` action_type rather than a new sentinel.

Below 30% sustained for 4 weeks → revisit Diagnostic's output quality at next Sunday review.

   486	
   487	#### A1. The Diagnostic — the sales tool
   488	
   489	- **Build wave:** v1.0 (week 4–5)

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	#
     3	# Diagnostic agent — cleanup.sh
     4	#
     5	# Status: Proposed (pre-W3-build scaffold; Day-12 author).
     6	# Reading order: agent.md §4 (workflow + gotchas) first — specifically
     7	# gotcha §6.1 (LinkedIn ToS: no profile data persistence beyond audit).
     8	#
     9	# Per ADR-003 v2 bundle pattern: cleanup.sh runs after cycle.sh succeeds
    10	# OR fails. Drops any transient state that wouldn't survive a real-world
    11	# multi-tenant render. Most critical: LinkedIn profile data MUST NOT be
    12	# cached to disk per their ToS.
    13	#
    14	# Invocation: bash cleanup.sh
    15	#
    16	# Exit codes:
    17	#   0  Cleanup successful (or nothing to clean)
    18	#   1  Cleanup failure on a critical path (LinkedIn cache still present)
    19	
    20	set -uo pipefail
    21	
    22	if [[ -z "${CTX_AGENT_DIR:-}" ]]; then
    23	  printf 'cleanup.sh: CTX_AGENT_DIR unset; nothing to clean\n' >&2
    24	  exit 0
    25	fi
    26	
    27	# shellcheck source=/dev/null
    28	source "${CTX_AGENT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/_shared/hook-helpers.sh"
    29	
    30	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    31	# 1 — LinkedIn transient cache purge (CRITICAL per ToS gotcha §6.1)
    32	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    33	#
    34	# At W3 build: tools/linkedin_readonly_connector caches profile responses
    35	# in /tmp/ifos-linkedin-cache-<pid>/. Even though tools.yaml sets ttl=0,
    36	# defense-in-depth: explicit purge here.
    37	
    38	LINKEDIN_CACHE_PATTERN="/tmp/ifos-linkedin-cache-*"
    39	PURGED=0
    40	
    41	# shellcheck disable=SC2086
    42	for cache_dir in ${LINKEDIN_CACHE_PATTERN}; do
    43	  if [[ -d "${cache_dir}" ]]; then
    44	    rm -rf "${cache_dir}"
    45	    PURGED=$((PURGED + 1))
    46	  fi
    47	done
    48	
    49	# Verify nothing left
    50	# shellcheck disable=SC2086,SC2012
    51	LEFTOVER=$(ls -d ${LINKEDIN_CACHE_PATTERN} 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    52	if (( LEFTOVER != 0 )); then
    53	  printf 'cleanup.sh: CRITICAL — LinkedIn cache not fully purged (%d dirs remain)\n' "${LEFTOVER}" >&2
    54	
    55	  hh_decision_action "linkedin_cache_purge_fail" "cleanup:${CTX_TENANT_SLUG}" \
    56	    "$(date +%s)" \
    57	    '{"escalation_code":"ESC_PII_LEAKAGE_RISK","reason":"LinkedIn cache purge incomplete"}' \
    58	    2>/dev/null || true
    59	
    60	  exit 1
    61	fi
    62	
    63	if (( PURGED > 0 )); then
    64	  printf 'cleanup.sh: purged %d LinkedIn cache dir(s)\n' "${PURGED}"
    65	fi
    66	
    67	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    68	# 2 — Web scraper response cache (lower-criticality; can persist 1h)
    69	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    70	#
    71	# Companies House cache stays per tools.yaml (7-day TTL).
    72	# Web scraper cache stays per tools.yaml (1-hour TTL).
    73	# Both are public data; no ToS purge mandate.
    74	
    75	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    76	# 3 — Audit row to confirm cleanup ran
    77	# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    78	
    79	hh_decision_action "diagnostic_cleanup" "agent:${CTX_AGENT_NAME:-diagnostic}" \
    80	  "$(date +%s)" \
    81	  "$(printf '{"purged_linkedin_cache_dirs":%d}' "${PURGED}")" \
    82	  2>/dev/null || true
    83	
    84	exit 0

docs/architecture/tenancy-invariants.md:12:IFOS is multi-tenant SaaS. Every tenant runs the same agent fleet (Diagnostic, Janitor, Scribe, Cash Conductor, Sourcing Scout, Concierge in v1.0) against their own data, isolated from every other tenant's data. **A single cross-tenant data leak is a catastrophic failure mode** — it breaches the GDPR contract, violates pilot LOI terms, and burns customer trust. There is no "minor" cross-tenant leak.

docs/architecture/agent-bundle-renderer-design.md:97:The two layouts share no files by name except `tools.yaml` (which the IFOS bundle uses for MCP servers and which Claude Code consumes at PTY spawn). cortextOS expects `config.json` (runtime config), `CLAUDE.md` (Claude Code's entry point), `.env` (Telegram credentials + secrets); IFOS provides `config.schema.json` (a *schema* for per-tenant config, not the materialised config itself), `agent.md` (the output contract + workflow, not a Claude Code entry point), and no `.env` (credentials live per-tenant). The bundle's `validate.sh` and `context.sh` have no cortextOS analogue — they implement IFOS-side Gate A and context-assembly per master brief §8.1 Changes 1+2, and need a defined invocation mechanism (Spec gap §1.1-A). The bundle's `tests/fixtures/` are CI-only and have no runtime counterpart in cortextOS. **Translation is required for three of the six bundle files** (`agent.md` → `CLAUDE.md` with cortextOS-required preamble synthesised in; `config.schema.json` → `config.json` materialised with per-tenant values from `/vault/{tenant}/_config.yaml`; `validate.sh` + `context.sh` → rendered into a hook location the agent can invoke). `README.md` and `tools.yaml` pass through. Fixtures stay in the source repo.

1. Header status is not a valid or consistent status. Line 3 sets `**Status:** Pre-Build-Round-17-Bilateral-Applied`, while §9 line 230 says `**Status:** Proposed`; the agent-bundle skill requires a status field whose state is honest and interpretable as Proposed/Accepted/In Force. Fix by setting the header to `**Status:** Proposed` and moving round-history into a separate note.

2. Gate A is still weaker than the declared contract. §3 lines 64-70 labels these as “Gate A hard-fails,” but lines 68 and 70 admit voice-classifier-unreachable and PII-whitelist-absent paths warn and exit 0; §5 lines 150, 154, and 157 repeat the warn-only behavior. Fix by either making those checks hard-fail now or narrowing the current Gate A contract so it does not claim those checks hard-fail.

3. §7 overstates the implemented voice-drift behavior. Line 197 says per-run `ESC_VOICE_DRIFT` fires after 3 retries, but §4 line 109 says the v0 generator has no retry loop and `validate.sh` performs a single classifier call. Fix by changing §7 to describe the v0 single-pass behavior and explicitly marking 3-retry behavior as W4-planned, or implement the retry loop before ratification.

4. The claimed fixture readiness conflicts with the actual canary expectations. §8 line 220 claims the 3 fixtures with golden outputs are built, but `fixtures/99-voice-drift-canary.yaml` expects `draft_file_at_tmp: true` and `decision_log_rows_min: 4`; §4 line 122 says `cycle.sh` deletes the draft on Gate A fail, and the workflow exits before cleanup. Fix the canary expectations or change the failure path so the fixture can pass as declared.
